requirements.title: Nav App Scheduled at 100 Hz
requirements.description: The nav app shall execute on the static schedule at 100 Hz throughout the mission.
requirements.rationale: Parent SYS-012 fixes nav output cadence at 100 Hz; the app runs at this rate.

requirements.title: IMU Message Subscription
requirements.description: The nav app shall subscribe to IMU messages on the software bus.
requirements.rationale: Parent SYS-002 requires live nav; IMU input enters the app via the bus.

requirements.title: Barometer Message Subscription
requirements.description: The nav app shall subscribe to barometric altimeter messages on the software bus.
requirements.rationale: Parent SYS-002 requires live nav; baro input enters the app via the bus.

requirements.title: GPS Message Subscription
requirements.description: The nav app shall subscribe to GPS fix messages on the software bus.
requirements.rationale: Parent SYS-002 requires live nav; GPS input enters the app via the bus.

requirements.title: Nav State Published at 100 Hz
requirements.description: The nav app shall publish a navigation state message on the software bus at 100 Hz.
requirements.rationale: Parent SYS-012 mandates nav state output rate at the app level.

requirements.title: Sixteen-State Composition Published
requirements.description: The nav app shall publish a navigation state containing position, velocity, attitude quaternion, and accelerometer and gyroscope biases.
requirements.rationale: Parent SYS-013 defines the 16-state composition; the app publishes it.

requirements.title: Nav State Timestamp
requirements.description: The nav app shall include a monotonic microsecond timestamp on every published navigation state message.
requirements.rationale: Parent SYS-012 output cadence and SYS-026 monotonic time base require per-message timestamps.

requirements.title: Validity Flag Published
requirements.description: The nav app shall publish a navigation validity flag on the software bus alongside each navigation state message.
requirements.rationale: Parent SYS-015 requires the validity flag to be observable to consumers.

requirements.title: Validity False on Missing Inputs
requirements.description: The nav app shall set the published validity flag false when required nav inputs are unavailable.
requirements.rationale: Parent SYS-059 mandates validity reflects degraded input state at the app boundary.

requirements.title: Continue Publishing on Missing Inputs
requirements.description: The nav app shall continue publishing navigation state at 100 Hz when one or more sensor inputs are unavailable.
requirements.rationale: Parent SYS-034 requires nav propagation to continue when sensor inputs drop.

requirements.title: Position Bound to Latest GPS Fix
requirements.description: The nav app shall keep its published position estimate within a configured horizontal distance of the latest GPS fix.
requirements.rationale: Parent SYS-014 mandates a black-box GPS divergence bound at the app boundary.

requirements.title: POSIX Build Functional Equivalence
requirements.description: The nav app shall produce identical published navigation state on POSIX and Pico2 builds for identical inputs.
requirements.rationale: Parent SYS-043 requires the POSIX build to be functionally equivalent to the Pico2 build.

requirements.title: Deterministic Navigation Output
requirements.description: The nav app shall produce deterministic navigation state output given identical sensor input sequences.
requirements.rationale: Parent SYS-044 requires deterministic outputs for repeatable Trick sim runs and regression analysis.

requirements.title: Boost-Phase Sensor Update Skipping
requirements.description: The nav app shall skip baro and GPS measurement updates during the boost phase.
requirements.rationale: PM directive 2026-05-03: GPS multipath and baro shock during boost (high-G, transient pressure) make those measurements unreliable; IMU-only dead-reckoning is the safer fusion strategy during the ~500 ms boost interval.

requirements.title: Post-Boost Settling Window for Sensor Re-Enablement
requirements.description: The nav app shall delay baro and GPS update re-enablement by one second after boost-phase exit.
requirements.rationale: PM directive 2026-05-03: 1-second settling window allows IMU bias estimates to converge after the boost-phase shock before fusion of GPS and baro resumes; configurable via NAV_APP_INIT_T for per-build tuning.
